title: Granular mixing and flow dynamics in horizontal stirred bed reactors
summary: Horizontal stirred bed reactors (HSBRs) are used in gas--phase polyolefin production, where efficient solids mixing and controlled residence time distributions are essential for product quality and stability. Despite their industrial relevance, the influence of operating conditions on granular flow and mixing in HSBRs is not well understood. Discrete Element Method (DEM) simulations are used to study the effects of rotation speed and fill level on particle motion, mixing, and axial transport in a lab--scale HSBR.
